title: Little Nachman Part 3
body:
Little Nachman was so excited that he didn’t stop praising Hashem’s name the whole trip. He thanked Hashem for answering his prayers and said, "Master of the World, thank You so much for listening to my prayers. Thanks to You, Hashem, I’m now on the way to see the tzaddik in Pollnoi. Thank You, my Father in Heaven, thank You with all my heart!"
 
Little Nachman actually succeeded in seeing the holy tzaddik Yaakov Yosef of Pollnoi. He was forever grateful to Rebbe Chaim Krosner for taking him along on this unforgettable trip.

To be continued, G-d willing
